name: application-secret-reveal-field
title: Secret Reveal Field
description: Masked secret value field with a reveal toggle and a copy button, distinct from application-api-key-manager since it displays and manages a single secret rather than a table of many keys.
useWhen: Displaying a single sensitive value, such as a webhook signing secret or an API key, masked by default.
Letting a user briefly reveal a secret to verify or copy it without permanently exposing it on screen.
Reminding a user to rotate a key that hasn't been refreshed recently.
avoidWhen: Multiple keys need to be listed, scoped, and revoked — use application-api-key-manager's table instead.
The value is not actually sensitive — a plain read-only field or application-copy-field is simpler.
The secret must never be rendered in the DOM even when masked — fetch and reveal it only on demand from your backend rather than pre-loading the real value.
responsiveBehavior: The field has a fixed max width; the monospace value truncates rather than wraps if the container is narrower than the value's rendered width.
accessibility: The reveal button carries aria-pressed reflecting whether the secret is currently shown, and its aria-label changes between 'Show secret' and 'Hide secret'.
The copy button has a real aria-label since it is icon-only.
The rotation warning pairs an icon with text, not color alone, to communicate the reminder.

variants.title: Reveal and copy
variants.description: Masked value with a reveal toggle, a copy button, and help text explaining how to reveal it.
accessibility: aria-pressed on the reveal button reflects whether the value is currently shown as plain text.

variants.title: Reveal and copy (Dark)
variants.description: Reveal-and-copy secret field adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Field text and icon button contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: With rotation note
variants.description: Secret field shown in its revealed state with a Rotate key action and a rotation-age warning note.
accessibility: The Rotate key action is a real button with visible text, not just an icon.

variants.title: With rotation note (Dark)
variants.description: Secret field with a rotation note, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Rotation warning background and text contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
